COPY apps/api/package.json apps/api/
COPY apps/web/package.json apps/web/

RUN npm ci --workspace @hackhub/api --include-workspace-root=false

WORKDIR /app

COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY package.json ./
COPY apps/api ./apps/api

USER app
EXPOSE 5000
